title: End of part one and start of part two
summary: Woods ends the first tape and opens part two, asking Grey to play.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: And at that we’re going to have to stop for right now. This has been Al Grey, and this has been an interview for Hamilton College, an interview with a great jazz artist. PART II ©Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

We are here with Al Grey and we are very flattered to have such a fabulous musician to help us here with our Hamilton College Archive that we’re developing. We interviewed him once before, but he has some marvelous things to share with us. Thank you for playing that little piece for us on the trombone. Play another little one for us. Just a couple of little licks.
Here’s one that we played all the time in the quintet.
